name: Reprobacy
overview: Scripture reveals reprobacy as God's righteous response to persistent human wickedness and rebellion, as seen in Genesis 6 where man's continual evil grieves the Lord and leads Him to judgment. The destruction of the corrupt places, such as in Genesis 19, further illustrates God's intolerance of sin. Commands given through Moses, like in Numbers 14 and Deuteronomy 1, reflect God's withdrawal of favor and protection from those who reject Him, underscoring the serious consequences of persistent disobedience.
